ev.q: Approximately 30% of medical visits for asthma by persons without health insurance occurred in emergency departments
SOURCE: National Ambulatory Medical Care Survey and National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey 2003 public use files.
compared with only 6% of visits by those with private insurance
The type of medical setting in which persons receive health care for asthma differs for those with private health insurance and those without health insurance.
